independent_language_unit: authored query template, not slot repetitions or training seeds

negative_subclass_revision.canonical_score_mapping: Keep six positive scores; take maximum over learned negative-subclass scores for the unified reject score. This preserves the argmax class decision after subclass-to-reject mapping.
negative_subclass_revision.name: V5b
negative_subclass_revision.score_scope: Softmax after max-negative mapping is a normalized decision score, not a calibrated probability.
negative_subclass_revision.taxonomy_source: existing V5a training-row family metadata; no new-held fields read
negative_subclass_revision.training_weight_policy: Preserve the original seven-class balanced per-example weights: every negative subclass uses the original unified-reject sample weight. Do not silently raise total negative mass by balancing eleven classes.

score_semantics: Softmax of learned linear scores. Logistic scores are multinomial logits; SVM softmax scores are normalized decision scores, not calibrated probabilities.
selection_rule: Among selection risk-feasible candidate/calibration pairs, maximize correctly accepted known count, then minimize accepted wrong known, OOD false accepts, actual serialized selected-state bytes, candidate name, confidence, margin. Coverage >=0.8 remains a separate mandatory gate. Include explicit reject-all fallback. Development diagnostic results never select a candidate.
training_data_kind: author-written synthetic English plus explicitly generated training combinations
